subject: EU core extension + APAC warmpath onboarding
messages:
From: Emilia Rossi <emilia@medinova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@medinova.com
Date: 2027-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Capacity top-up request + EU primary / APAC failover during renewal

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the heads-up on the renewal window. We ran a Q3 traffic model and expect a 2.8x peak increase if our APAC pilot follows the early metrics — attached is the pulse report. We need to align on three things before the November renewal is finalized:

1) EU as the primary region for data residency and legal controls (GDPR alignment).
2) An APAC warmpath (failover/standby route) for burst traffic during business hours in APAC, seeded in stages.
3) A firm commitment on capacity top-up SKUs and an estimated monthly delta for our finance team.

High level ask: can Redwood commit to EU-primary production (data at rest + processing in EU), with APAC nodes configured in warmpath (no primary writes, KV mirroring for fast failover) and an onboarding timeline we can include in our SOW?

If you can send a mutual action plan and a draft quote, procurement will take it to contracts. We need the plan to include runbook snippets for failover and a short ops checklist for cutover verification.

Attachments: traffic_report_q3.pdf (summary), sample-traffic-graphs.csv

Best,
Emilia
Procurement Lead, MediNova Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emilia Rossi <emilia@medinova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up request + EU primary / APAC failover during renewal

Emilia —

Appreciate the detail and the report. We can support the EU-primary residency with an APAC warmpath configured as you described. Next steps from our side:

- Draft MAP with milestones (we'll attach). Key milestones: contract sign, EU-core capacity extension deploy, APAC seed nodes (canary), full warmpath activation, verification window.
- Proposed SKU top-up: 4 x XL inference instances (EU), 2 x L warmpath standby nodes (APAC) with auto-burst to shared pool.
- Estimated monthly delta: see attached MAP_draft.docx for line items; rough ballpark is ~€32k/month incremental (final number after Ben's quote).

Operational notes: we recommend a two-week canary in APAC with traffic shaping (10% → 30% → 60%) and KV prefix priming to minimize cold-start latencies. We will produce a short runbook excerpt for your ops team.

I'll loop in Marissa and Ben for delivery cadence and quotes. Do you have any compliance evidence we should pre-stage (SCCM/SOC pointers) beyond standard SOC2?

—Jordan
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_draft.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-12-03T10:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up request + EU primary / APAC failover during renewal

Team — internal coordination notes for DN-3392 (MediNova):

Summary of asks from customer: EU-primary residency; APAC warmpath seeded in stages; capacity top-up and a clear MAP included in renewal SOW.

Operational checklist (high priority):
- EU node sizing: confirm kernel/quantization profile for customer's production model (need model fingerprint from research team).
- APAC warmpath: configure standby nodes with KV mirror only; set failover policy to read-only fallback until health check passes.
- Canary plan: 14-day window, traffic ramp steps [10, 30, 60, 100] with rollback triggers on latency or error budget breach.
- Observability: enable per-route token-level latency and token-cost sampling; set an SLO alert to page on sustained 5xx > 0.5% over 10m.

Action items:
1) Ben — produce firm quote by EOD 2027-12-04 (capacity_quote_v3.xlsx) including one-time onboarding and monthly delta.
2) Karthik — confirm contract language options for residency and failover SLA; will need legal redline window.
3) Soojin — ops readiness: can you draft the runbook excerpt and the cutover checklist? Include rollback steps and verification queries.
4) Jordan/Marissa — we'll assemble the MAP and send to Emilia by 2027-12-06.

Note: procurement requested a doc showing SOC2 controls + data residency attestation. We have a templated pack; attach when we send MAP.

On quoting cadence, Ben: include committed reserved hours for EU inference vs. burst pool pricing for APAC.

—Marissa
VP, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up request + EU primary / APAC failover during renewal

Quick numbers — rough quote attached (capacity_quote_v3.xlsx). Highlights:
- One-time onboarding & cutover support: €18,500 (8 engineer-days)
- EU committed capacity (4 x XL instances): €27,500/month
- APAC warmpath standby (2 x L nodes + burst pool): €6,200/month + burst metering
- Estimated total delta: €51,500 first month (includes one-time fees), €33,700/month thereafter.

Constraints/notes:
- We can guarantee EU data-at-rest and processing within EU for the committed capacity. APAC warmpath will hold encrypted KV mirrors with key material controlled in EU KMS until failover is triggered (meet compliance ask).
- Need signed SOW that specifies failover triggers and a post-cutover verification period (recommended 7 days).

I'll finalize the spreadsheet and hand it to Karthik for contract language alignment.

—Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: capacity_quote_v3.xlsx
From: Emilia Rossi <emilia@medinova.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@medinova.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-12-09T15:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up request + EU primary / APAC failover during renewal

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement reviewed Ben's quote and the MAP draft — overall this matches our expectations. We have two small asks before we sign:

1) Add a 7-day verification SLA in the SOW with explicit rollback conditions (we want the option to revert APAC routing if latency > 100ms P95 for 30m).
2) Provide the SOC2 + residency attestation pack referenced in Marissa's note.

If you can incorporate those two items into the MAP and send a final SOW, we can route for legal approval this week and aim to sign by Friday. Also please send a calendar invite for the APAC cutover planning call (30–45m) — target next Wednesday.

I'll attach procurement signatures once the SOW is final.

Best,
Emilia
Procurement Lead, MediNova Health
Quoted attachments referenced earlier: traffic_report_q3.pdf, capacity_quote_v3.xlsx
